figures.title_en: A compact lateral baseline defines a conditional heading observation

panels.visual: 作者供给机器人照片，标两天线/Go2IMU/商业融合装置位置，不由照片断言准确天线序号

figures.legend_en: Platform and heading geometry. (a) The supplied photograph shows the compact quadruped installation. (b) The fixed receiver order defines the lateral baseline and its relation to the IMU and evaluation midpoint. (c) Heading uses the horizontal baseline projection; an inclined lateral baseline does not generally yield Euler yaw without an attitude model. Nominal separation and declared lever arms are installation parameters rather than an independent survey.

figures.title_en: Measurement eligibility determines when auxiliary observations enter the estimator
figures.dominant_claim_zh: 辅助观测受不同准入与依赖条件控制，而非六个互相独立的输入。

panels.label: b
panels.visual: heading exactpair→BOTH_FIXED→wrap gate；A1heading虚线→HV外部Ĉ；global GNSS入口AND→RP/HV；主面板占60%

figures.legend_en: Eligibility and aiding structure. Solid arrows carry measurement inputs, while dashed arrows denote preparation or dispatch dependencies. Heading requires exact receiver-time pairing, qualifying receiver status and wrapped-residual admission. Robot horizontal velocity is formed using the heading stream and SDK tilt, and robot aids are also subject to the GNSS update entrance. Covariance inflation remains bounded. The graph represents the archived configuration rather than independent information channels.
figures.results_topic: The proposed configuration makes heading and robot-aid eligibility explicit.

figures.legend_en: Navigation agreement in three natural recordings. Panels (a–c) show signed yaw discrepancies and panels (d–f) horizontal position discrepancies relative to the commercial fusion reference. Proposed denotes the archived LegSA-GINS configuration. Curves retain each method’s frozen matching support; paired statistics are reported separately. Reference and estimator share GNSS lineage, so the panels characterize agreement rather than independent absolute accuracy.
figures.results_topic: Natural recordings yield approximately two-degree heading agreement at the frozen midpoint contract.

figures.title_en: Regional yaw differences coexist with reversals outside the selected region
figures.dominant_claim_zh: BY2O选定区域的优势与窗外反转同时成立。

panels.visual: BY2O yaw时间曲线，以淡色标primary/secondary且outside完整显示

panels.visual: 区域状态支持/持续时间信息，不只突出最优区域

figures.legend_en: Regional comparison in BY2O. (a) Signed yaw discrepancies retain the full recording, with primary and secondary intervals marked. (b) Region definitions and receiver-state context distinguish the selected interval from its complement. (c) Existing paired intervals summarize common-support differences, including the outside-region reversal. Region selection used the recorded sequence and is not an independently prespecified held-out evaluation.
figures.results_topic: The selected region supports a local difference, while its complement prevents a global ordering claim.

figures.title_en: Finite-output distributions must be read with completion and failure outcomes
figures.dominant_claim_zh: 完整CORE的分布只有结合失败分母才能界定配置表现。

panels.label: a
panels.visual: yaw finiteECDF：Basic position + heading EKF、Heading-gated position/velocity EKF、Without inflation、Proposed；前两者为联合结构对比，非RV单因素

figures.legend_en: Controlled-case distributions and outcomes. (a,b) Empirical distributions of yaw and horizontal-position RMSE are conditional on finite completed outputs for the displayed configurations. (c) Completion, divergence and unavailable-heading initialization retain the original 541-case denominator. The proposed configuration completes 519 cases, with 13 divergences and nine unavailable initializations. Case placements reuse a recorded trajectory and do not represent independent field realizations. The basic and heading-gated position/velocity baselines differ jointly in receiver-velocity updating, heading weighting and admission, and update route; their difference is not an isolated receiver-velocity effect.
figures.results_topic: The full CORE reveals finite performance gains together with nonzero failure boundaries.
figures.supplement: 全部11配置ECDF/61类型heatmap、其他量纲与原全部588案例状态。
figures.visual_notes: fail灰/红/纹理固定；ECDFlegend写nfinite/N541；无输出不得贴到x0。；F02/F03只写joint structural contrast，不能标RV toggle或归因RV独立增益。

figures.title_en: Component effects differ across horizontal vertical and heading quantities
figures.dominant_claim_zh: 单组件信息加入的收益并不一致：水平收益可同时伴随竖直或航向负向。

panels.label: a
panels.visual: 四单变量×H/Up/yaw等主要quantity的lower/higher计数；每格全pairedN

panels.label: b
panels.visual: 同四组件meanΔ与medianΔ两个分开展示，不以mean颜色标胜负

figures.legend_en: Single-component effects on common completed cases. Lower and higher counts compare the full configuration with the corresponding one-switch ablation; missing membership is retained separately. Means and medians summarize the same saved paired differences. Robot horizontal velocity lowers horizontal RMSE in 472 of 519 pairs, while vertical RMSE is higher in 365 pairs. The counts are descriptive for dependent controlled cases, not independent-trial significance tests.
figures.results_topic: The ablations support conditional component effects rather than uniform all-axis improvement.
figures.supplement: 56行全量direction/v2v3合同；组合关闭A07–09与同源标定/初始条件表。
figures.visual_notes: 所有四组件展示相反方向，慎用绿=成功；mean/median单位分别deg/m不能共用一条数轴。

figures.title_en: Heading availability conditions robot-velocity aiding during outages
figures.dominant_claim_zh: heading保留与全GNSS失效是不同信息条件，HV不能被描述为无条件续桥。
figures.legend_en: Outage information conditions in the original addendum. (a) The masks distinguish simultaneous loss of position, receiver velocity, Doppler velocity and heading from position-related loss with heading retained; robot-aid eligibility follows the preparation and dispatch dependencies. (b,c) Whole-window horizontal RMSE retains all 27 complete-loss and 18 heading-retained cases. These scores do not by themselves describe in-outage updates, endpoint errors or recovery.
figures.results_topic: Robot-velocity aiding is conditional on surviving heading and update eligibility.
figures.supplement: 135新合同fault/endpoint/recovery全量独立版本；actualGNSS-anchoraccepted账本，而非provider timestamp当更新时刻。
figures.visual_notes: 顶部资格matrix先读后两个散点，单位log尺度注明；不用fault-time图词描述wholewindow。

figures.title_en: Availability accompanies angular agreement across observation routes
figures.dominant_claim_zh: 不同GNSS航向路线必须同时报告支持与角量，较差结果只属于所列条件。
figures.legend_en: Angular agreement and output support for raw-observation compass and moving-base routes. Inputs and project adaptations are identified before the numerical results. Output counts use each declared formal window; held values are distinguished from fresh valid solutions. Angular metrics retain their declared projection-heading and reference-yaw definitions. Large discrepancies under this installation do not establish universal method inadequacy or a same-input solver ordering.
figures.results_topic: External angular results must be interpreted jointly with their observation contract and availability.
